texts.sign.of.the.cross: In the name of the Father, ✠ and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.
texts.dialogue.opening.longer: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Spirit be with you all.
texts.penitential.act.invitation: Brothers and sisters, let us acknowledge our sins, and so prepare ourselves to celebrate the sacred mysteries.
texts.penitential.act.text:
I confess to almighty God
and to you, my brothers and sisters,
that I have greatly sinned,
in my thoughts and in my words,
in what I have done and in what I have failed to do,
through my fault, through my fault,
through my most grievous fault;
therefore I ask blessed Mary ever-Virgin,
all the Angels and Saints,
and you, my brothers and sisters,
to pray for me to the Lord our God.
texts.penitential.act.absolution: May almighty God have mercy on us, forgive us our sins, and bring us to everlasting life.
texts.gloria.text:
Glory to God in the highest,
and on earth peace to people of good will.
We praise you,
we bless you,
we adore you,
we glorify you,
we give you thanks for your great glory,
Lord God, heavenly King,
O God, almighty Father.
Lord Jesus Christ, Only Begotten Son,
Lord God, Lamb of God, Son of the Father,
you take away the sins of the world,
have mercy on us;
you take away the sins of the world,
receive our prayer;
you are seated at the right hand of the Father,
have mercy on us.
For you alone are the Holy One,
you alone are the Lord,
you alone are the Most High,
Jesus Christ,
with the Holy Spirit,
in the glory of God the Father.
Amen.
texts.gospel.announcement: A reading from the holy Gospel according to N.
texts.gospel.end.response: Praise to you, Lord Jesus Christ.
texts.creed.nicene.text:
I believe in one God,
the Father almighty,
maker of heaven and earth,
of all things visible and invisible.
I believe in one Lord Jesus Christ,
the Only Begotten Son of God,
born of the Father before all ages.
God from God, Light from Light,
true God from true God,
begotten, not made, consubstantial with the Father;
through him all things were made.
For us men and for our salvation
he came down from heaven,
and by the Holy Spirit was incarnate of the Virgin Mary,
and became man.
For our sake he was crucified under Pontius Pilate,
he suffered death and was buried,
and rose again on the third day
in accordance with the Scriptures.
He ascended into heaven
and is seated at the right hand of the Father.
He will come again in glory
to judge the living and the dead
and his kingdom will have no end.
I believe in the Holy Spirit, the Lord, the giver of life,
who proceeds from the Father and the Son,
who with the Father and the Son is adored and glorified,
who has spoken through the prophets.
I believe in one, holy, catholic and apostolic Church.
I confess one Baptism for the forgiveness of sins
and I look forward to the resurrection of the dead
and the life of the world to come. Amen.
texts.creed.apostles.text:
I believe in God,
the Father almighty,
Creator of heaven and earth,
and in Jesus Christ, his only Son, our Lord,
who was conceived by the Holy Spirit,
born of the Virgin Mary,
suffered under Pontius Pilate,
was crucified, died and was buried;
he descended into hell;
on the third day he rose again from the dead;
he ascended into heaven,
and is seated at the right hand of God the Father almighty;
from there he will come to judge the living and the dead.
I believe in the Holy Spirit,
the holy catholic Church,
the communion of saints,
the forgiveness of sins,
the resurrection of the body,
and life everlasting. Amen.
texts.offertory.blessing.bread: Blessed are you, Lord God of all creation ... it will become for us the bread of life.
texts.offertory.blessing.wine: Blessed are you, Lord God of all creation ... it will become our spiritual drink.
texts.offertory.invitation: Pray, brothers and sisters, that my sacrifice and yours may be acceptable to God, the almighty Father.
texts.preface.response_2: We lift them up to the Lord.
texts.preface.let_us_give_thanks: Let us give thanks to the Lord our God.
texts.preface.text: It is truly right and just ... with the Angels and all the Saints we declare your glory, as with one voice we acclaim:
texts.sanctus.text:
Holy, Holy, Holy Lord God of hosts.
Heaven and earth are full of your glory.
Hosanna in the highest.
Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord.
Hosanna in the highest.
texts.memorial.acclamation_1:
We proclaim your death, O Lord,
and profess your Resurrection
until you come again.
texts.memorial.acclamation_2:
When we eat this Bread and drink this Cup,
we proclaim your death, O Lord,
until you come again.
texts.memorial.acclamation_3:
Save us, Saviour of the world,
for by your Cross and Resurrection
you have set us free.
texts.doxology: Through Him, with Him, and in Him, O God, almighty Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, all glory and honor is yours, for ever and ever.
texts.lords_prayer.invitation: At the Saviour’s command and formed by divine teaching, we dare to say:
texts.lords_prayer.post:
Deliver us, Lord, we pray, from every evil,
and grac­iously grant peace in our days,
that, by the help of your mercy,
we may be always free from sin and safe from all distress,
as we await the blessed hope
and the coming of our Saviour, Jesus Christ.
texts.lords_prayer.post.response:
For the kingdom,
the power and the glory are yours
now and for ever.
texts.peace.prayer: Lord Jesus Christ, you said to your Apostles ... Who live and reign for ever and ever.
texts.peace.prayer_2: The peace of the Lord be with you always.
texts.peace.invitation: Let us offer each other the sign of peace.
texts.agnus_dei.text:
Lamb of God, you take away the sins of the world,
have mercy on us.
Lamb of God, you take away the sins of the world,
have mercy on us.
Lamb of God, you take away the sins of the world,
grant us peace.
texts.agnus_dei.prayer:
Behold the Lamb of God,
behold him who takes away the sins of the world.
Blessed are those called to the supper of the Lamb.
texts.agnus_dei.lord_i_am_not_worthy:
Lord, I am not worthy
that you should enter under my roof,
but only say the word
and my soul shall be healed.
texts.blessing: May almighty God bless you, Father, ✠ Son and Holy Spirit.
texts.dismissal: Go forth, the Mass is ended.
